1.explanation_en: 到 is the arrival predicate; the attached 了 marks the arrival as a completed event. The subject and destination remain outside this unit.
看 is “look,” and the attached durative 着 presents the looking as ongoing. The object stays separate.
推 means “push”; attached 着 marks the action as ongoing while the cart remains a separate object.
开 means “bloom”; 得 links it to 正好, which describes the degree or manner of the blooming.
结 means “form,” and 为 introduces the resulting status 兄弟. Together they describe entering that relationship, rather than merely tying or forming an unspecified object.
带 means “bring” or “take”; attached 着 presents the group of horses as accompanying what the merchant brings. The horses remain separate.
斩 means “cut down”; attached 了 marks the action as completed. The person acted on remains separate.
取得 means “obtain” or “achieve”; attached 了 marks this achievement as a completed event. The victory remains separate.
围 means “surround,” and resultative 住 conveys the enclosing result; attached 了 marks the event as completed. The city remains separate.
打 means “fight”; attached 了 marks the bounded action before the separate duration phrase 一会儿.
占 means “gain” or “occupy”; attached 了 marks the change as having occurred. The advantage remains separate.
到 is the arrival predicate; the attached 了 marks arrival as a completed event. The destination remains separate.
靠 means “be beside” or “lean against”; attached 着 presents the resulting position as continuing. The location stays separate.

打 means “hold” here; attached 着 presents that as a continuing state. 打着红旗 describes the army, with 红旗 as the separate object and 的 linking the description to 军队。 The context supports carrying or holding flags, without specifying how they are held aloft or displayed.
挡 means “block,” and resultative 住 conveys that the way is obstructed; attached 了 marks the result as achieved. The route remains separate.
带 means “take” or “bring”; attached 着 presents the people as accompanying the group as they flee. 剩下的人 is the separate object of 带着.
关 means “confine”; attached durative 着 describes the person’s ongoing confined state. 的 and 人 remain outside the unit.
听 means “listen,” and resultative 完 marks the listening as completed.
救 means “save”; resultative 下 presents the person as successfully saved or secured. The person remains separate.
押 means “escort under guard,” and directional 走 adds movement away. 后, which marks what follows, stays separate.
同意 means “agree”; attached 了 marks the agreement as an event that occurred.
冲 means “rush”; directional 上去 adds movement upward and away from the reference point. In this unstressed directional use, 去 is neutral tone.
救 means “save”; resultative 下 presents the person as successfully saved or secured. The person remains separate.
杀 means “kill”; attached 了 presents the killing as carried through to completion in this stated intention. The person remains separate.
留 means “leave,” and resultative 下 conveys what remains; attached 了 marks the result as established. The suspense remains separate.
